race.comment: FARCITED (6) is an interesting runner second up off a very long spell. He was given a quiet ride first up here over 1000m, getting a mile back behind an all-the-way winner but running on very well for third. He can settle a lot closer from an inside gate out to 1100m here and improve quickly. PRINCE TYCOON (2) comes through the Creswick Stakes having tried hard there for second after leading the inside division. He's a speedy sort who will give a sight again. SIGNATURE SCENT (3) came off a short spell and won well against her own sex over this route last time in a tidy win. She should get every hope again trailing a good speed and take plenty of beating once more. AFTERBERNA (4) was solid in the Creswick and did win well enough here prior. She draws ideally for Willo and has claims. JENNI THE NINJA (7) next best off a sound run behind SIGNATURE SCENT.
